subject: Exercise primes the brain's glymphatic system to clear metabolic waste
script: From Agewell Brief: Exercise primes the brain's glymphatic system to clear metabolic waste. New research links physical activity to the brain's waste-removal network, offering a mechanistic path to healthier aging. Every day, your brain generates metabolic debris—protein fragments, lipids, and other byproducts of neural activity. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
